description: S46 T3 (MG5-reads/MG8/MG13): mcp.servers is the person's management list — the row-complete read the CLI table becomes. Filtered here to one agent's enabled private servers (every filter is optional; pointers keep absent-vs-empty distinct). The transport carries env NAMES only — there is no field where a value could travel (MG13/§4c made structural). The two servers show the probe join's three states: one probed (the same cache mcp.status reads — this door never probes, MG11) and one never-yet-asked as the distinct word "unprobed". declaredBy is the COUNT of agents whose declares name one of its tools (the list of names is mcp.server's, not this read's).
